senses.gloss: clearness of the sky after the rainy season.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 59a:14">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>הרואה רקיע בטָהֳרָתָהּ</he> (or <he>בטַהֲ׳</he>) he who sees the sky in its restored brightness (Ms. F. <he>בטיהרו</he>, v. <cite ref="I00317"><he>טִיהָר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Berakhot 59a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>נראית רקיע בטהרתה</he> (Ms. M. <he>נראו שמים בטהרה</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 335">Yalk. Is. 335</cite> <he>נראה שמים בטִהֲרוֹ</he>, corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Shabbat 152b">Sabb. 152ᵇ</cite> <he>תנה לו כמו שנתנה לך מה הוא בט׳ אף אתה בט׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) give her (the soul) to Him as He has given her to thee, as He (has given her) in pureness, so give thou &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 16a:1">Ber. 16ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 24:6">Num. XXIV, 6</cite>) <he>מה נחלים … מטומאה לט׳ וכ׳</he> as the rivers raise man from a condition of uncleanness to one of cleanness, so do the tents (schools) &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 8a:17">Ab. Zar. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>עובדי ע״ז בט׳</he> encouraging idolatry, though from no impure motives.

Yoma 72ᵇ; Men. 110ᵃ הלומד תורה בט׳ he who studies the Law in (sexual) purity.—Snh. l. c. וטַהֲרָתָן במה שהן and their purification (immersion) is performed in whatever condition they are (whole or torn); a. v. fr.—Esp. ט׳ or טַהֲרַת הקודש observance of levitical rules originally prescribed for the handling of sacred food; also (mostly in pl.) secular food so prepared or pretended to be so prepared; v. חָבֵר.—

<cite ref="Gittin 62a:3">Gitt. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>אין עושין חלת ע״ה בט׳</he> you must not separate the priest’s share under levitical precautions for a non-observant (because it might mislead the priest); <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 3:1">Tosef. Dem. III, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 13a:2">Sabb. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>עד היכן פרצה ט׳ וכ׳</he> how far the custom of observing the rules of levitical cleanness for secular food has spread &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 2:7">Ḥag. II, 7</cite> <he>היה אוכל על ט׳ הקודש</he> used to eat his ordinary meals with the observance required for sacred food; a. fr.—Pl. <he>טָהֳרוֹת</he>, <he>טַהֲרוֹת</he>. Tosef. Dem. l. c. <he>אין עושין ט׳ לע״ה</he> one must not prepare food with observance of levitical precautions for &c., v. supra.
<cite ref="Berakhot 19a:16">Ber. 19ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:6">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>כל ט׳ שטיהר וכ׳</he> all objects which R. … had declared clean.

Tosef. Dem. II, 20 אין משלחין ט׳ וכ׳ you must not send food levitically prepared through a non-observant; a. v. fr.—Tohŏroth, or Tahăroth, (euphem. for טומאות), name of the sixth order of the Mishnah and Tosefta (סדר ט׳), and of one treatise of that order.
